title: From Communist to Venture Capitalist
coreMove: Use origin stories as diagnostic context without letting them become proof.
sourcePressure: The chapter grounds Horowitz's later doctrine in formation: political contradiction, authority, incentives, technical execution, and the move from individual competence to company responsibility.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version is treating biography as colorful career background or automatic credential.

hook: every founder has an origin story
career path from ideology to capitalism

exampleSpecs.audience: a safety chair evaluating a captain whose military habits shaped cockpit decisions
exampleSpecs.stakes: the board must learn from the habit without treating service history as either excuse or proof
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the chair separates the captain's formation column from the evidence column on the incident board, then tests which inherited reflex matched the present flight conditions
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a cockpit voice transcript clipped beside a faded squadron photo

exampleSpecs.domain: museum conservation lab choosing a restoration method
exampleSpecs.audience: a head conservator weighing a technician's old apprenticeship against current pigment data
exampleSpecs.stakes: using the familiar method may permanently alter a painting
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the conservator labels the technician's apprenticeship as context, then makes the team test a pigment sample before approving the repair
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a tray of blue pigment flakes under a magnifier lamp

exampleSpecs.domain: cybersecurity firm reviewing a breach-response lead
exampleSpecs.audience: a COO deciding whether an ex-intelligence analyst's secrecy reflex fits a commercial client crisis
exampleSpecs.stakes: withholding too much information could preserve control while destroying client trust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the COO asks which part of the secrecy instinct came from prior training and which part is justified by the current client facts, then changes the update cadence
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a breach timeline projected beside a blacked-out incident memo

exampleSpecs.domain: shipyard apprenticeship program promoting a master welder
exampleSpecs.audience: a yard manager deciding whether craft excellence predicts supervision quality
exampleSpecs.stakes: the wrong promotion could slow a submarine repair contract
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the manager marks where the welder's formation helps quality control and where it may miss scheduling, then assigns a trial shift with explicit feedback rules
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a weld coupon stamped with inspection numbers beside a repair schedule

exampleSpecs.domain: legal aid clinic hiring a director from a protest organization
exampleSpecs.audience: a clinic board assessing mission fire against case-management discipline
exampleSpecs.stakes: clients need both moral urgency and reliable filings
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the board maps the candidate's organizing instincts to client intake needs, then asks for a filing backlog plan instead of applauding the origin story
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an intake folder with a court deadline stamped in red

exampleSpecs.domain: semiconductor fab line lead moving into plant management
exampleSpecs.audience: a VP assessing whether precision-tool experience scales to cross-shift leadership
exampleSpecs.stakes: a yield drop could cost millions if the wrong reflex governs escalation
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the VP asks the lead to name which clean-room instincts improve escalation and which one might hide people issues, then writes both into the promotion plan
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a wafer defect chart glowing above a sealed clean-room window

skillTargets: use biography as context without treating it as proof
test inherited reflexes against current facts
distinguish origin credibility from present fit

tryThisNowSpec: Pick one strong instinct you use at work, write where it was learned, then write one current condition that could make that instinct mislead you.
sourceAnchorsNote: source contains no named anecdote for this chapter

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: prevents the timestamp+named-protagonist template from dominating the chapter

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm - a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following 'concrete anchor -> abstract rule -> elaboration'
